resources.string: Transfer installed apps offline between phones in seconds
Phone A taps SEND and selects any installed app (supports split APKs).
Phone B taps RECEIVE to pair via Nearby, or scans the Hotspot QR code.
APK downloads to Downloads/APK Share and installs with one tap.

App data (login sessions, chats, settings, and saved game progress) is NOT transferred — only the APK installation file(s) are transferred. Some paid apps, DRM-protected apps, and banking apps may refuse to install from an extracted APK. System apps cannot be shared.
Please allow Install unknown apps for APK Share, then come back and tap Install again.
Shows live progress and completion alerts for app transfers
